highlights: Enterprise AI has pivoted heavily toward agentic orchestration, with specialized frameworks like NVIDIA's PivotOPD and Humanize targeting error recovery and multi-agent consensus to guarantee deterministic execution.

A major shift toward cost-efficiency and on-device optimization is underway, highlighted by Anthropic's Claude Haiku 5.5 pricing input at an ultra-low $0.10/M tokens and Liquid AI's zero-output-token decision models.
Real-time resource optimization tools are maturing, featuring live LLM inference auction marketplaces and adaptive reasoning-enabled guardrail models like AdaGuard.

agents.title: NVIDIA PivotOPD Teaches Multi-Turn AI Agents to Recover From Pivotal Mistakes
agents.summary: This framework introduces an on-policy distillation method that specifically trains multi-turn LLM agents to detect early mistakes and recover from them, substantially outperforming 13 baselines on agent benchmarks.

agents.title: Humanize: Judgement Engineering for Agentic Coding
agents.summary: A multi-agent orchestration workflow built around mechanically enforced gates between planning and review phases, enabling developer loops to self-correct and achieve flawless scores on rigorous science and math olympiad benchmarks.

agents.title: Can AI Agents Make Open-Ended Scientific Discovery? Evidence from Station
agents.summary: By augmenting agents with a Supervisor mechanism and periodic Meta Reflection, the Station environment allows LLM teams to autonomously rediscover over 62% of criteria from recent top-tier scientific papers without web access.

models.title: JetBrains Releases Mellum2.1: A 12B MoE Open Model for Coding Agents
models.summary: An Apache 2.0-licensed, 12B mixture-of-experts model designed specifically for software engineering tasks, boosting its SWE-bench Verified score from 2.0% to 47.0% through target repository reinforcement learning.

models.title: Liquid AI Releases Open-Weight d1-3B and d1-omni-600M: Multimodal Decision Models With Zero Output Tokens
models.summary: These open-weight decision models process complex text, image, and audio inputs to return calibrated, typed answers in a single forward pass without generating costly, slow text output tokens, making them perfect for real-time edge processing.

models.title: Anthropic Releases Claude Haiku 5.5: A Small Model With 1M Context
models.summary: Haiku 5.5 delivers high-speed performance across a massive 1-million token context window at a highly disruptive price point of $0.10 per million input tokens, excelling at OSWorld benchmarks.

tools.title: Architect Launches Liquid Inference, a Real-Time Auction for LLM Inference
tools.summary: A dynamic LLM router that functions as a live auction where providers compete to fulfill developer prompts, reducing operational costs through automated lowest-offer matching with a simple base URL swap.

tools.title: Meta AI Open-Sources Rebalancer: A C++ Assignment Solver
tools.summary: An Apache 2.0-licensed library optimized for distributing massive traffic, shards, and server allocations, handling millions of complex linear and mixed-integer programming problems daily.

tools.title: AdaGuard: Enhancing Safety and Policy Compliance with Reasoning-Enabled LLM-As-A-Judge Guardrails
tools.summary: A GRPO-trained, runtime adaptive safety engine that dynamically switches between fast classification and explainable reasoning-on-demand, saving significant latency costs while matching the safety performance of frontier models.

companies.title: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for Everyone
companies.summary: OpenAI has rolled out GPT-6 with a native Intelligent UI that delivers visual, interactive components, moving standard chat interactions into dynamic workspaces users can explore directly.

companies.title: Atlassian and OpenAI Expand Partnership to Turn Enterprise Knowledge into Action
companies.summary: An expanded collaboration integrating OpenAI's frontier models natively with enterprise knowledge bases to automate product management, planning, and task delivery across product suites.

companies.title: How Jump Trading is Scaling Quant Research with ChatGPT
companies.summary: The quantitative trading firm outlines how they scaled automated financial analysis pipelines using longer-running multi-source LLM workflows paired with robust human evaluation loops.

learning.title: A Model Guide for the GPT-6 Family
learning.summary: A practical guide for startups and developers on how to choose appropriate model tiers, adjust reasoning efforts, refine prompt instructions, and structure tool coordination for high-throughput production.

learning.title: A Developer’s Guide to Laya: Zero-Shot Decisions and Calibration
learning.summary: A step-by-step programming tutorial explaining how to leverage the open-source Laya engine to build typed decisions, fit custom temperatures, and construct robust system abstention gates.

learning.title: Google DevFest 2026: Build, Secure, and Scale in the Agentic AI Era
learning.summary: Google's developer community event series returns with active labs and workshops geared towards security, optimization, and scaling multi-agent networks.
